entries.title: Travel Activity MCP Services
entries.technologies: Python, FastAPI, Model Context Protocol, Terraform, AWS ECS
entries.description: MCP services at Veltra that expose the travel-activity catalog to Claude and ChatGPT apps, plus internal analytics tools. The activity-search connector is listed in Anthropic's public Claude connector directory.

entries.title: WareX — Logistics SaaS API
entries.technologies: Go, Echo, GORM, MySQL, JWT/RBAC, Minio/S3, GKE, CircleCI
entries.description: Senior backend engineer and top-3 author on the Go API of WareX, a production logistics 'warehouse-exchange' SaaS at Gaussy. Owned the warehouse, contract, workspace, document and pricing resources and the team's integration-test harness.

entries.title: golem — LINE-bot Fund Analytics
entries.technologies: Ruby on Rails 5, React, JSON:API, LINE Messaging API, gnuplot
entries.description: Lead author of a multi-tenant Rails 5 + React platform that delivers fund and bond analytics (net-asset-value graphs, factor analysis) to users as LINE Flex Messages and generated charts, with HMAC webhook verification, at Robotfund.

entries.title: bumblebee — Race-free TTS Caching Service
entries.technologies: Go, CSP concurrency, LAME (PCM→MP3), Docker, AWS
entries.description: Go service written alone at Robotfund, in front of a pool of text-to-speech servers: channel-owned state with no data races (verified with `go test -race`), PCM-to-MP3 transcoding, content-digest caching and per-host load distribution.

entries.title: Reuters Market-Data Pipeline
entries.technologies: Go, AWS Lambda, DynamoDB, S3, Reuters DataScope Select
entries.description: Solo Go AWS Lambda that ingests daily Reuters DataScope Select market data into an idempotent DynamoDB/S3 state machine, built on an extracted MIT-licensed Reuters DSS Go client library, at Robotfund.

entries.title: FupIntuition — IoT/Edge People Analytics
entries.technologies: Go (amd64 + ARM), BLE beacons, WiFi sniffing, HashiCorp Vault, GPG-signed OTA, S3 apt repo
entries.description: Sole author, at Allm, of a Go daemon for in-store edge devices that counts staff via BLE and repeat customers via WiFi and runs face recognition, with a web UI and a signed over-the-air update pipeline.

entries.title: FAST-ED Clinical Triage API
entries.technologies: Ruby, Grape, GraphQL, Pundit, HMAC, bcrypt
entries.description: Lead author, at Allm, of a versioned stroke/cardiac triage API for hospitals (Grape + GraphQL + Pundit), with HMAC request signing and bcrypt authentication with login lockout. Co-built its Vue 2 + Apollo admin SPA.

entries.title: Griffon — Mobile MMORPG Backend
entries.technologies: Ruby, Padrino, ActiveRecord, MySQL, Resque, RSpec
entries.description: Backend engineer at Aiming on the live Ruby/Padrino backend of 'Griffon' (幻塔戦記グリフォン), a mobile MMORPG published in Japan and Korea. Owned the achievements, friendship, reward-distribution and guild-battle matchmaking systems, with idempotency enforced in the database.

entries.title: IronFunctions — Open-source Serverless Platform
entries.technologies: Go, Docker, Vue, Express, JWT, CircleCI
entries.description: Open-source contributor to IronFunctions at iron.io, an early Docker-based FaaS platform (later the Fn Project). Added JWT auth and the CI/CD release pipeline to its web UI, and engine features such as a payload-as-stdin runner.

entries.title: This Résumé Site
entries.technologies: ReScript, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, PDFKit, docx
entries.description: Static résumé site in English, Japanese and Turkish, prerendered to HTML. One content source produces the page and the PDF, DOCX, JSON Resume and vCard files at build time; hosted on GitHub Pages.
